stem: After the hawks rebuilt their nest, fewer people complained most likely because —

options.label: A
options.text: the sidewalk below the nest stayed clean

options.label: B
options.text: they realized that the hawks were not going to leave

options.label: C
options.text: they were tired of explaining their concerns to others

options.label: D
options.text: the nest was not as large as the first nest the hawks had built
